name: 41433-meanpoolembed-0.6b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B (bfloat16), stood up as an EMBEDDING model with MEAN pooling.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90. Run on an otherwise idle node and do not load the node's other seven GPUs while this runs.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine, one GPU, and a SINGLE API server process (`--api-server-count` left at the engine's default of 1).
architecture: Dense decoder, Qwen3ForCausalLM: 28 layers, hidden 1024, 16 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, bfloat16, ~0.6B params (~1.2 GB); the rest is readable off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, request rate unbounded. Bounded at 20000 requests with a 900 s safety cap; first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion, leaving 16000 scored. 64 streams is the declared operating point, not a dial: a run at another concurrency is a different setup and it will complete without error.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix_buckets, seed 1, freshly sampled. Prompt EXACTLY 512 tokens (min = max = 512). `output_tokens: 1` is inert -- an embedding request generates nothing -- and is present only because the synthetic_text data spec expects a value. Sent to `/v1/embeddings`, which `spec.backend.request_format` pins; a run against a generation endpoint is a different setup and it will complete without error.
purpose: A semantic search embedding service turning 512-token passages into vectors for 64 concurrent clients on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B

# Both explicit rather than left to `auto`: `auto` resolves off the architecture suffix and
# selects the generative runner for this checkpoint, at which point `/v1/embeddings` does not
# exist and the serve fails.
runner: pooling
convert: embed

# Declared, not a default left standing: a decoder under `convert: embed` resolves to LAST.
pooler-config: {"pooling_type": "MEAN"}

# A hard requirement of the pooling method, not a preference: the engine asserts on a
# partially-prefilled sequence reaching a MEAN pooler ("partial prefill not supported with MEAN
# pooling") and the run dies rather than degrading.
enable-chunked-prefill: false

# The scheduler mode this item is defined at (problem.md sec.2), PINNED rather than left to the
# engine's default -- for a `runner: pooling` engine that default resolves to OFF, not on.
async-scheduling: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-model-len: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.80

# Deliberately absent: host / port / served-model-name, api-server-count (engine default of 1),
# dtype, enforce-eager, enable-prefix-caching, block-size, seed, kv-cache-dtype, quantization,
# compilation-config, and pooler-config.dimensions / enable_chunked_processing / max_embed_len.
